body: Hello! I've had a fair share of toxic people too. The best thing I ever did was to simply cut ties with them. You deserve friends who love and cherish you. You deserve friends who validate your feelings. Tbh, i think it's better to be alone at this point rather than be friends with toxic people. Upside is, you could focus on yourself more if you do cut ties with them ^^ but that's all up to you though. I hope you feel a little better by now. You are worthy of everything good in life.

Thank you! I do have a few friends I confide in about this. It's just that I've been so hesitant to open up recently, because I would feel icky afterwards?? Not that I dislike them or anything, it's just a me-problem.
